name: Eedi Misconceptions Graph
summary: Common math misconceptions, each linked to the skills (Eedi constructs) it hinders, drawn from students' answers to Eedi's diagnostic questions.

access_note: In the Learning Commons Knowledge Graph's open files; its REST API doesn't serve it. The open release doesn't link misconceptions to standards.
cite: Eedi Ltd. (2026). Eedi Misconceptions Graph v1.0. Distributed through the Learning Commons Knowledge Graph.

fits.how: A teacher picks the misconceptions the AI listens for, found by the words of a goal or a standard; the harness carries 8,117 misconceptions and the 2,258 constructs they hinder.
